name: Montclair Place
description: Montclair Place is a premier regional shopping destination in the Inland Empire, offering an extensive collection of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment including a movie theater. With convenient access from major freeways and a climate-controlled environment, this mall provides a comprehensive shopping experience for families and individuals seeking popular national brands and local favorites.
summary: Montclair Place is a major enclosed regional mall in the Inland Empire featuring extensive shopping, dining, and entertainment options.
